tasks.name: Handle blocking work, cancellation, and async resources

concepts.name: asyncio.run entry point
concepts.description: `asyncio.run()` owns an event loop for a top-level awaitable and must not be nested in another running asyncio event loop in the same thread.

concepts.name: asyncio.gather
concepts.description: `asyncio.gather()` runs awaitables concurrently and returns results in argument order; its default sibling-failure behavior is weaker than TaskGroup.

concepts.name: asyncio.TaskGroup
concepts.description: `asyncio.TaskGroup` (Python 3.11+) provides structured concurrency: it owns child tasks, waits on scope exit, cancels remaining children after a child failure, and can raise grouped failures.

concepts.name: asyncio.Semaphore
concepts.description: `asyncio.Semaphore` limits the number of tasks simultaneously holding permits and works naturally with `async with` for acquire/release.

concepts.name: asyncio.Queue backpressure
concepts.description: A bounded `asyncio.Queue` provides producer backpressure; `get()`, `task_done()`, and `join()` coordinate unfinished-work accounting.

concepts.name: asyncio.Lock
concepts.description: `asyncio.Lock` provides task-level mutual exclusion around critical sections, useful for protecting shared state across coroutine suspension points.

concepts.name: asyncio.to_thread
concepts.description: `asyncio.to_thread()` runs a synchronous callable in a worker thread and is primarily useful for blocking I/O that must not stall the event loop.

concepts.name: asyncio.timeout
concepts.description: `asyncio.timeout()` (Python 3.11+) creates a deadline scope, uses cancellation internally, and exposes expiry as `TimeoutError` outside the context.

concepts.name: Cancellation cleanup
concepts.description: Asyncio cancellation is delivered with `CancelledError`; cleanup should be robust and explicitly caught cancellation should generally be propagated afterward.

concepts.name: async for
concepts.description: `async for` consumes asynchronous iterators whose `__anext__()` method returns awaitables and whose end-of-iteration signal is `StopAsyncIteration`.

concepts.name: AnyIO task groups
concepts.description: AnyIO task groups provide structured child-task lifetimes, start child work inside the group, and expose a cancellation scope for coordinated cancellation.

concepts.name: HTTPX AsyncClient
concepts.description: HTTPX `AsyncClient` provides awaited async requests and reusable connection pooling; client instances should be reused rather than recreated inside hot loops.
